fp_policy: -ffast-math -ffp-contract=off in ALL numerical variants; strict harness; auto_strict evidence separate
batch_policy: AXPY reset per batch; calls repeated updates; shared calls per case/repeat; 2 warmup batches
clock: steady_clock + grouped cpu_core user cycles/instructions/LLC-misses around batch + separate invariant TSC ticks
pmu: cpu_core type=4; cycles=0x3c instructions=0xc0 LLC-misses=0x412e; excludes kernel/hypervisor; raw unscaled counts; running/enabled >95%
